events.title: Mewtations: Dogma is at Steam Next Fest — play the demo!
events.summary: Hi everyone, MixMig here! Mewtations: Dogma is taking part in Steam Next Fest, and the free demo is ready to play! Whether you found us through the festival or have been following the cats for a while, thank you for stopping by. Come stack some cards, build a home, craft gear and send your cats on expeditions. events.title: The Mewtations: Dogma demo is out now!
events.summary: The free Mewtations: Dogma demo is now available on Steam! Build a home for your cats by dragging, stacking and combining cards. Gather resources, craft equipment and prepare your crew for automatic battles—all under the shadow of the dog mafia. Play the demo Try it for yourself and tell us what you think. events.title: First Gameplay Trailer — and a Demo at Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: First, an apology Hi everyone, it's MixMig, the solo dev behind Mewtations: Dogma. I owe you an apology. For a long time this page has been almost completely silent: no updates, no news, not even a "still alive!" post. That wasn't because the project stopped. It was the opposite. I've been heads-down, pushing as hard as I can to get a playable demo ready in time for Steam Next Fest, and every spare hour went into the game instead of into posts. That changes today.
